page.layout: One page with a table: years in the left margin beside groups of names, and a right-hand column of small marginal notes beside the lists. A printed bracketed number ("[4]") sits at the foot below the table, and "33" at the head.

main_text.l: 1506 | Johan Schaffer.Groninga in fidem ED-SARDI concedit, exclusis Saxonibus.
1507 | Herman Lewe.Cognitio controversiæ inter SAXONEM & Groning. institutâ Con-stitutiæ, cognitoribus à Maxi-miliano Cæs. ordinibus Germ. datis.
1509 | Thezo Jarges.Edsardus novare quædam in rep. Groning. molitus fuit.
1511 | Herman Lewe.Denuò cognitio controversiæ instituta Novelii[?], a.Xo.é[?] Saxone, reis Edsardo & Groninganis.
1512 | Herman Lewe.Idem repertum Coloni-æ, præsente ac præside ipso Maximil. Cæsare, Gerbrandus Moccama, & Gemma Iuvvsma capit-[?] mulctari Leoardiæ.

page.notes: Years are in the left margin, one per group of names. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept. "Cæf" in the 1507 note is read as Cæs. The 1511 note has "Novelii", "a.Xo.é" and "reis" as printed; the first two are doubtful. The word after "capit-" in the 1512 note is illegible at the line end. The printed "[4]" at the foot is given as a signature. The page number 33 at the head is handwritten-looking but printed.
